entry.title: Best Gaming Accessories Under Budget in Pakistan (2026)
entry.content:
You don't need to spend a fortune to build a proper gaming setup. The best gaming accessories under budget in Pakistan now come with the same core features you'd find on premium gear, RGB lighting, decent sensors, comfortable ear cups and durable switches, just without the flagship price tag. This guide walks through what actually matters in a mouse, keyboard, headset and the smaller extras, so you can spend your budget on the upgrades that make a real difference to your gameplay.

What Counts as a Gaming Accessory?

Before comparing individual products, it helps to know what you're actually shopping for. The core budget gaming setup usually includes:

  • A gaming mouse
  • A gaming keyboard (membrane or mechanical)
  • A gaming headset
  • A mousepad sized for your play style
  • Optionally, a controller, webcam or a basic cooling accessory for your PC

You don't need every item on day one. Most gamers get the biggest jump in performance from a good mouse and a proper mousepad first, then upgrade the keyboard and headset as budget allows.

Best Budget Gaming Mouse: What to Look For

A gaming mouse is one of the most important accessories for competitive play, whether you're on FPS titles like Valorant and Counter-Strike, battle royales like PUBG, or MOBA games. Before buying, check:

  • Sensor and DPI: a reliable optical sensor with adjustable DPI (commonly 800 to 6,400 or higher on budget models) matters more than chasing the highest number on the box
  • Polling rate: 500Hz to 1000Hz keeps input lag low for fast-paced games
  • Wired vs wireless: wired mice remove any risk of input lag or battery dependency, and are usually cheaper; budget wireless options have improved a lot but still cost a bit more for the same core performance
  • Grip and weight: try to match the mouse shape (palm, claw or fingertip grip) to how you actually hold a mouse
  • Programmable buttons: useful for MMO and MOBA players who rely on quick macro access

In Pakistan, brands like Redragon, A4Tech's Bloody line, Marvo, Havit and Logitech's entry-level G-series dominate the budget mouse segment, offering RGB lighting, adjustable DPI and programmable buttons at accessible prices.

Best Budget Gaming Keyboard: What to Look For

Keyboards in this budget bracket generally split into two types:

  • Membrane keyboards: cheaper, quieter, and perfectly fine for casual gaming and everyday typing
  • Mechanical keyboards: pricier but offer tactile, consistent keypresses that many competitive gamers prefer, and they tend to last longer under heavy use

Whichever type you choose, prioritize:

  • Anti-ghosting and n-key rollover, so multiple simultaneous keypresses register correctly in fast-paced games
  • A layout that fits your desk (full-size, tenkeyless, or a compact 60 percent layout if space is tight)
  • Backlighting if you game in low light, though this is a nice-to-have rather than a performance factor
  • Build quality: a stable base and consistent keycaps matter more long-term than RGB effects

Redragon has a particularly wide range of budget mechanical keyboards available in Pakistan, spanning full-size, tenkeyless and compact 60 percent layouts with hot-swappable switches on some models.

Best Budget Gaming Headset: What to Look For

A gaming headset needs to do two jobs well: deliver clear audio and pick up your voice cleanly for team communication. Look for:

  • Driver size: 40mm to 50mm drivers generally give a fuller sound at this budget
  • Microphone quality: a noise-canceling or boom mic makes a real difference in team-based games
  • Comfort: padded ear cups and an adjustable headband matter if you play for long sessions
  • Connectivity: a 3.5mm wired headset works across PC, consoles and mobile with zero setup; USB and wireless options add convenience at a slightly higher price

A headset that also works comfortably for calls and everyday listening gives you more value for the same spend, since it isn't limited to gaming sessions only.

Don't Skip the Mousepad

A proper mousepad is one of the cheapest upgrades with a noticeable impact on mouse tracking accuracy, especially compared with gaming directly on a desk surface. Extended mousepads that cover both your mouse and keyboard area are worth considering if you play fast-paced FPS titles that need a lot of arm movement.

Combo Kits: The Smartest Way to Start on a Budget

If you're setting up a gaming station from scratch, 2-in-1 and 4-in-1 combo kits (keyboard, mouse, headset and sometimes a mousepad bundled together) are usually the most budget-efficient way to get started. They cost less than buying each piece separately, and brands like Redragon and Marvo offer several combo kits specifically built for first-time gaming setups in Pakistan. You can always upgrade individual pieces later as your budget grows.

Buying Tips for Gaming Accessories in Pakistan

  • Watch for counterfeits: budget gaming brands like Redragon and A4Tech Bloody are popular enough in Pakistan's local markets to attract counterfeit clones with fake specs and weaker build quality. Buying from an authorized online retailer with warranty and return policies reduces this risk significantly.
  • Check the return and warranty policy before ordering, especially for mechanical keyboards and wireless mice, since defective switches or sensors are the most common early failures.
  • Match accessories to your platform: PC gamers have the widest accessory choice, while console gamers should double check compatibility (some gaming mice and keyboards are PC-only).

FAQs: Best Gaming Accessories Under Budget in Pakistan

What is the most important gaming accessory to upgrade first on a budget? A gaming mouse paired with a proper mousepad usually gives the biggest noticeable improvement for the smallest spend, ahead of a keyboard or headset upgrade.

Is a membrane or mechanical keyboard better for budget gaming? Membrane keyboards are cheaper and quieter, which suits casual gamers and shared spaces. Mechanical keyboards cost more but offer more consistent keypresses and generally last longer, which competitive gamers tend to prefer.

Are wireless gaming mice good enough for competitive play on a budget? Modern budget wireless mice have closed most of the performance gap with wired ones, but a wired mouse remains the safer, cheaper choice if input lag is a serious concern for you.

Which gaming accessory brands are popular and reliable in Pakistan? Redragon, A4Tech's Bloody line, Marvo, Havit and Logitech's entry-level range are the most common budget gaming brands available through Pakistani retailers, alongside pricier options like SteelSeries and HyperX for buyers who want to spend a bit more.

Are combo kits worth buying instead of separate accessories? For a first-time setup, yes, generally. A keyboard, mouse and headset combo kit costs less than buying each item individually, and you can always replace a single piece later once you know which upgrade matters most to you.

How do I avoid counterfeit gaming accessories in Pakistan? Buy from an authorized online retailer that offers warranty coverage and a clear return policy, and be cautious of prices that seem far lower than every other listing for the same exact model.

Buy Gaming Accessories Online in Pakistan

Telex's Gaming Components & Accessories collection covers the full budget gaming setup in one place, including gaming keyboards and mice, standalone keyboards, keyboard and mouse combos and mouse pads from trusted brands like Redragon, Marvo, Logitech and SteelSeries.

Compare specifications, check the warranty terms, and pick the combination that matches how and where you actually play before you order.

Final Verdict

The best gaming accessories under budget in Pakistan aren't necessarily the ones with the most RGB zones or the highest number on the spec sheet. Start with a mouse and mousepad that suit your grip and games, add a keyboard and headset that match your typing and communication needs, and consider a combo kit if you're building a setup from zero.

entry.title: Best Laptops Under 1 Lakh in Pakistan 2026: Students, Freelancers & Office Use
entry.content:
Buying a laptop under Rs. 100,000 in Pakistan requires careful comparison. At this budget, buyers need to balance processor performance, RAM, storage, display quality and battery life.

 

Whether you are a university student, freelancer, remote worker or office professional, the best laptop under 100000 in Pakistan should provide reliable performance for everyday tasks without unnecessary features that inflate the price.

What Can You Get in a Laptop Under Rs. 100,000?

Depending on the brand and configuration, a laptop under 1 lakh in Pakistan can be suitable for:



  • Microsoft Office
  • Online classes
  • Browsing
  • Freelancing
  • Zoom and video meetings
  • Content writing
  • Basic programming
  • Accounting
  • Business applications
  • Basic photo editing

 

For demanding gaming, advanced video editing or professional 3D work, plan on a higher budget instead.

Key Specifications to Check

Processor

The processor is one of the most important components in this budget range. For students and office users, an efficient modern Intel or AMD processor can provide enough performance for browsing, documents, presentations and multitasking.

 

Don't pick a laptop based only on the processor's generation or model number. Consider the complete configuration alongside it.

RAM

For a new laptop, 8GB RAM is a practical starting point for most students and office users. If your work involves heavy multitasking, editing or professional applications, 16GB provides a noticeably more comfortable experience.

SSD Storage

An SSD improves everyday responsiveness significantly compared with older hard drive based systems. For most users, a 256GB or 512GB SSD gives a good balance between speed and storage space.

Display

If you spend several hours studying or working on a laptop, display quality matters. Look for:



  • Full HD resolution
  • Good viewing angles
  • Comfortable brightness
  • A suitable screen size for your use case
  • Anti-glare properties where available

Best Laptop for Students in Pakistan

Students generally need a laptop that is portable, reliable and capable of handling documents, research, presentations, online classes and entertainment. A good student laptop in Pakistan should ideally have:



  • 8GB RAM or more
  • SSD storage
  • Full HD display
  • Good battery life
  • A comfortable keyboard
  • A lightweight design

 

You don't necessarily need a gaming laptop for university work; that budget is often better spent on RAM, storage and battery life.

Best Laptop for Freelancers in Pakistan

Freelancers may need more performance depending on their profession.

For writers and virtual assistants

Prioritize:



  • A fast SSD
  • A comfortable keyboard
  • Good battery life
  • Reliable Wi-Fi
  • A portable design

For developers

Look for:



  • A strong processor
  • At least 8GB RAM
  • SSD storage
  • Upgradeability where possible

For graphic designers

A better display and stronger processor become more important here. Depending on the software, dedicated graphics may also be useful.

For video editors

Video editing requires significantly more processing power and memory than the categories above. If you regularly edit high resolution video, consider moving beyond the Rs. 100,000 category for a smoother workflow.

HP vs Dell vs Lenovo: Which Should You Choose?

HP, Dell and Lenovo are among the most recognizable laptop brands available to Pakistani buyers, and each covers this budget with several different laptop lines aimed at different users. Instead of choosing a brand purely on popularity, compare:



  • Processor
  • RAM
  • SSD
  • Display
  • Build quality
  • Battery
  • Warranty
  • Upgrade options

 

The same brand can sell laptops designed for completely different users, so the model matters more than the badge on the lid.

New vs Used Laptop Under 100,000 in Pakistan

A used or refurbished business laptop (think Dell Latitude, HP EliteBook/ProBook, or Lenovo ThinkPad lines) can sometimes offer stronger build quality and specifications for the same budget than an entry-level new laptop. A new laptop, on the other hand, gives you greater peace of mind through a full manufacturer warranty and untouched components.

 

If you're buying used, carefully inspect:



  • Battery health
  • Screen condition
  • Keyboard
  • Ports
  • SSD/HDD health
  • Charger
  • Overall physical condition
  • Warranty status: you can verify this directly through the manufacturer's own lookup tool, for example HP's warranty checker, Dell's warranty checker, or Lenovo's warranty lookup, using the device's serial number or service tag

 

For buyers who prefer a warranty-backed product with no guesswork, purchasing a new laptop from a trusted retailer is generally the safer choice.

FAQs: Best Laptops Under 100,000 in Pakistan

Which is the best laptop under 100000 in Pakistan for students? There's no single best model, it depends on your course load and budget split. Prioritize 8GB RAM or more, an SSD, and a Full HD display over raw processor speed; battery life and keyboard comfort matter just as much for day-to-day university use.

 

Is 8GB RAM enough for a laptop under 100,000? For browsing, documents, online classes and light multitasking, yes. If you regularly run editing software, multiple heavy apps at once, or development tools, 16GB is worth prioritizing over other upgrades.

 

Should I buy an SSD or HDD laptop at this budget? SSD, without much debate. The everyday speed difference (boot time, app loading, file transfers) is large enough that it should take priority over a bigger HDD at a similar price.

 

HP, Dell, or Lenovo: which brand is best for a laptop under 1 lakh? All three make solid options in this range, so compare the specific model's processor, RAM, display and warranty terms rather than picking by brand alone. Service center availability in your city is also worth checking before you decide.

 

Is a used laptop better value than a new one under 100,000? Often, yes, in terms of raw specifications: a used business laptop can outperform a new entry-level model. But a new laptop offers full warranty coverage and no unknown history, which matters more to some buyers than the specs on paper.

 

Can I get a Core i5 laptop under 100,000 in Pakistan? It depends on the generation and configuration, and pricing shifts often enough that a fixed answer here would go stale quickly. Compare current listings directly rather than relying on a spec claim from an older article.

Buy Laptops Online in Pakistan

Online shopping makes it easier to compare laptop specifications, prices and configurations before purchasing. Telex offers laptops across categories including student laptops, business laptops, gaming laptops, notebooks and 2 in 1 laptops.

 

Before ordering, check the processor, RAM, storage, operating system, warranty and exact model number against what's listed on the laptops category page.

Final Verdict

The best laptop under 100000 in Pakistan isn't necessarily the laptop with the highest specifications on paper.

 

Students should prioritize portability, battery life and reliability. Freelancers should choose according to their profession. Office users should focus on productivity and comfort over raw power.

 

Always compare the complete specification and warranty terms before making your purchase.

entry.title: Best Mobile Phones Under 50,000 in Pakistan 2026 Top Picks & Buying Guide
entry.content:
Finding the best mobile under 50,000 in Pakistan can be challenging because there are so many smartphones competing for attention in this price bracket. Buyers today expect more than just a good-looking phone a good mobile price in Pakistan under 50000 should still get you a capable processor, a reliable camera, long battery life, a quality display, and dependable software performance.

In 2026, the budget smartphones Pakistan market offers strong options for students, professionals, gamers, and everyday users. Before comparing individual models, it's worth understanding which specifications actually matter and which ones are just marketing noise when you're shopping for the best mobile phones under 50000 Pakistan 2026.

What Should You Expect from a Phone Under Rs. 50,000?

A budget of Rs. 50,000 now buys you features that used to be reserved for pricier devices. Depending on the model, you can typically find:

  • Large, high-refresh-rate displays (90Hz–144Hz)
  • 4G LTE connectivity, with true 5G still mostly sitting just above this budget for now (more on that below)
  • 50MP or higher-resolution cameras
  • Large batteries (5,000mAh and up)
  • Fast charging
  • 8GB RAM options
  • 128GB or 256GB storage
  • Gaming-leaning processors from MediaTek and Qualcomm
  • Modern Android software with multi-year update commitments

Specifications shouldn't be the only factor, though. A higher megapixel count, for example, doesn't automatically mean better photos sensor size and image processing matter just as much.

Best Mobile Phones Under 50,000 in Pakistan by Category

Best Overall Phone Under 50,000 in Pakistan

If you want one best mobile phone in Pakistan for everyday use, look for a device that balances display quality, a reliable mid-range processor, strong battery life, and capable cameras rather than one that overperforms in a single area. Samsung's A-series, Xiaomi's Redmi series, and Infinix's Hot series are the brands that show up most often in this bracket, and for most buyers a balanced all-rounder beats a phone built around one gimmick.

Best Camera Phone Under 50,000 in Pakistan

Camera-focused buyers should look past the megapixel number on the box. What actually matters:

  • Main camera sensor size
  • Image processing (the software behind the sensor)
  • Low-light performance
  • Video recording quality and stabilization (OIS/EIS)
  • Front camera quality for video calls and selfies

A well-optimized 50MP camera on a Tecno, Realme, or Vivo model can outperform a phone with a higher megapixel count but weaker processing don't let a spec sheet number make the decision for you.

Best Gaming Phone Under 50,000 in Pakistan

For gaming, the chipset is the single most important line on the spec sheet. Prioritize:

  • A capable MediaTek Helio/Dimensity or Qualcomm Snapdragon chipset
  • A high-refresh-rate display (120Hz or higher)
  • At least 8GB RAM (with virtual RAM extension as a bonus, not a substitute)
  • Good thermal management so performance doesn't throttle mid-session
  • A large battery paired with fast charging

If you regularly play demanding titles, prioritize the processor and cooling over camera specs.

Best Battery Phone Under 50,000 in Pakistan

If all-day battery life is your top priority, look for a large battery paired with an efficient chipset. A 5,000mAh cell is now common in this price category, but real-world battery performance also depends on the display technology (AMOLED is generally more efficient than LCD at low brightness), chipset efficiency, and how well the software is optimized.

Can You Get a 5G Phone Under Rs. 50,000 in Pakistan?

5G is an increasingly important box to tick when future-proofing a new phone. As of 2026, though, genuinely 5G-capable devices in Pakistan are still mostly priced a step above the 50,000 mark the segment is moving fast, so it's worth checking Telex's live mobile phones listings for the newest arrivals rather than relying on a fixed price point, since this can change within months.

If 5G isn't available in your budget yet, don't let that be a dealbreaker: Pakistan's 5G rollout is still expanding city by city, so a fast, efficient 4G phone will comfortably serve most buyers for the next few years. Compare the processor, camera, battery, and display first network generation second.

Check PTA Approval Before Buying

One of the most important things to check before buying any mobile phone in Pakistan is whether the device is PTA approved. A PTA approved phone is registered to legally work on Pakistan's cellular networks; an unregistered one can lose network access after 60 days of local SIM use.

Before you buy, always check:

  • PTA approval status verify directly on the PTA DIRBS portal using the phone's IMEI (dial *#06# to find it)
  • Warranty coverage
  • Seller authenticity
  • IMEI documentation
  • Return policy
  • Product condition (new vs. open-box vs. used)

Telex's PTA approved mobiles selection makes it easier to shop with this already confirmed, so you're not left doing the DIRBS check after the fact.

How to Choose the Best Mobile Under 50,000

Compare these specifications side by side before you commit:

Processor

The chipset drives everyday performance, gaming, and multitasking more than any other spec.

RAM

For most users, 6GB–8GB RAM is comfortable, though real world smoothness still depends on software optimization as much as the number on the box.

Storage

128GB is a solid starting point for most people. If you shoot a lot of photos and video, look for a 256GB variant.

Display

Look for a bright panel with a high refresh rate if smooth scrolling and gaming matter to you AMOLED over LCD if it's within budget.

Camera

Don't judge a camera by megapixels alone; sensor quality and image processing matter far more.

Battery

A large battery paired with an efficient chipset delivers the best real world endurance, not battery size alone.

Charging

Fast charging is especially useful if you're a heavy, all day phone user who can't always plan around a full overnight charge.

FAQs: Best Mobile Phones Under 50,000 in Pakistan

Which phone is the best mobile under 50,000 in Pakistan right now? It depends on what you value most there's no single universal answer. For balanced daily use, look at Samsung's A series or Xiaomi's Redmi series; for camera performance, compare Tecno, Realme, and Vivo's latest mid rangers; for gaming, prioritize chipset and cooling over brand. Because pricing shifts often, check current listings rather than relying on a "best of" list that may be out of date.

Can I get a 5G phone under Rs. 50,000 in Pakistan? Not reliably yet as of 2026 most genuine 5G devices still sit just above this budget, though the gap is closing quickly as more models launch. A fast 4G phone remains a perfectly practical choice in the meantime.

How do I check if a mobile is PTA approved before buying? Dial *#06# to get the IMEI, then check it on the official PTA DIRBS portal or by texting the IMEI to 8484. Buying from an already PTA-approved listing avoids this step entirely.

Is 8GB RAM enough for a phone under 50,000? For most everyday use social media, streaming, light gaming, multitasking yes. Heavy gamers or power users may prefer to prioritize a stronger chipset over chasing extra RAM.

Which brands offer the best value under 50,000 PKR? Samsung, Xiaomi, Infinix, Tecno, and Realme all field multiple models in this bracket, each with a different strength Samsung on software support and resale value, Xiaomi and Realme on specs-for-money, Infinix and Tecno on display and camera hardware at the price.

Is it safe to buy a mobile phone online in Pakistan? Yes, from an established seller just confirm PTA approval, official warranty coverage, and the return policy before checkout.

Buying a smartphone online can save time and open up a wider range of models and prices than a single local shop can offer. Before placing an order, verify the product specifications, warranty terms, PTA status, payment options, and return policy.

Final Verdict

The best mobile phone under 50,000 in Pakistan ultimately depends on what matters most to you. For gaming, prioritize the processor and cooling. For photography, focus on the camera system and image processing. For everyday use, look for a balanced mix of performance, battery life, display, and software support.

Before you finalize a purchase, compare current mobile prices in Pakistan, full specifications, warranty terms, and PTA approval status side by side.
